Working within a lean, international finance team, you will collaborate with external accounting firms and tax advisors across multiple jurisdictions. You will help strengthen financial controls, improve reporting accuracy, and streamline accounting processes in a dynamic digital asset environment. General ledger accounting: Prepare and manage journal entries, accruals, prepayments, and other accounting adjustments to ensure accurate financial records. Financial closing: Coordinate monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities across group entities, working closely with external accounting firms to ensure timely and accurate reporting. Reconciliations and account analysis: Perform balance sheet and bank reconciliations, investigate discrepancies, and ensure account balances are accurate, complete, and properly supported. Intercompany accounting: Manage monthly intercompany reconciliations, recharges, and settlements across multiple entities, ensuring consistency and resolving outstanding differences. Tax and VAT compliance: Support VAT reporting and other tax compliance activities across jurisdictions, including VAT returns, reverse-charge transactions, and withholding taxes, in collaboration with external tax advisors. Audit preparation: Prepare supporting documentation and audit files, coordinate information requests, and assist with interim and annual external audits. Internal controls and process improvement: Identify opportunities to strengthen financial controls, improve accounting workflows, and increase the efficiency and reliability of financial operations. Cross-functional accounting support: Contribute across the full accounting cycle, balancing routine processing with complex technical accounting tasks while maintaining high standards of accuracy and consistency. International collaboration: Work effectively with external service providers and colleagues across jurisdictions to ensure accounting practices remain aligned with applicable requirements and reporting deadlines. Experience working with multi-entity organizations, intercompany accounting, and preferably group consolidation. Hands-on Accounts Payable experience, including invoice processing, payment preparation, supplier reconciliations, and approval workflows. Experience preparing for and supporting external audits, including compiling documentation and responding to auditor requests. Proficiency with accounting software and strong Excel skills; familiarity with Xero and ApprovalMax is an advantage. The ability to manage both routine accounting operations and complex technical tasks independently, accurately, and consistently. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate discrepancies, identify risks, and recommend process improvements. A proactive, detail-oriented, and organized working style, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines. Excellent English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within a remote, international team. French language skills are a plus. An interest in cryptocurrency, digital assets, or crypto accounting is an advantage. The ability to work autonomously while contributing to a collaborative, international finance environment. Benefits Annual performance bonus: BORG token bonus to reward contributions to the organization. Remote and flexible working: Genuine flexibility to work remotely and organize your schedule effectively. Generous annual leave: 25 days of annual leave, in addition to local public holidays.
